column3: Saori Route ・ Complete Recovery
After coming home from school that night, I received a mail on my phone.
Title: Sorry for making you worry.
Is it from Saori? Let me see...
Eh... She says she'll be discharged tomorrow?
It's great that it wasn't anything bad!
Why are you all smiles, looking at your mail?
Uwah?! Don't look!
There's no way that you have a girlfriend, so it's probably a mail from that black one or something, right?
Let me see what it's all about♪
Hey! Don't peek!
...Huh?
Ah...
...What is this?
Saori was hospitalized?
Furthermore, you knew about it and kept silent up till now?
I-It's just some lightheadedness. It's not anything big.
I-I see...
But I didn't have any modeling work, so I could have visited her if you had told me...!
Look, just calm down. She just didn't want to make you worry.
I-It has nothing to do with you...
Kirino isn't happy about this...
But I guess she can't be feeling good about being kept in the dark about her friend getting hospitalized.
Don't get so angry! Saori had her own circumstances...
...I don't care about her!
...Huh?
What's that? You don't care? Aren't you two friends?
Friends... So what?
She might not think that way.
...She didn't tell me that she got hospitalized after all.
She has completely turned sulky... Although she's usually arrogant, she can be surprisingly delicate.
This is where Big Brother will come in and perk her up.
This is the time when I should provoke her, and since she's prideful, she'll definitely take the bait!
Well then, I'll help her myself.
Because I'm her friend.
...【Do whatever you want】.
Ah... What?
You're leaving? Aren't you going to help me?
You're going to help her yourself, right? Then it has nothing to do with me!
Could it be that Kirino...
is super angry over the fact that she was kept in the dark about Saori's hospitalization?
What do you mean by "do whatever you want"?
Are you not Saori's friend?!
As I call out to her as she leaves, Kirino doesn't even look back.
Ah, so that's how it is. I get it, I get it.
If that's how it is, I'll do whatever I want as you suggested.
...*sigh* C'mon, don't make me worry... geez...
Kirino? Did you say something?
...Nothing.
